requirements.title: Transfer authority, source balances and notice branch
requirements.requirement: The governing body may by resolution transfer unencumbered or unexpended appropriation balances at the budget officer’s request or upon its own motion after publication of notice. Determine which branch and which transfers apply; do not assume publication is required under the budget-officer-request branch.
requirements.finding: The January 5 treasurer’s memo requests reappropriation; the January 26 minutes record unanimous adoption of Resolution 6508. These records do not establish whether each transfer involved an eligible balance, the treasurer’s budget-officer authority, or whether notice was needed and published for any body-initiated transfer.
requirements.next: Obtain the signed resolution, budget-officer designation, fund-level ledgers and transfer authorizations, and any applicable publication notice.

requirements.title: General fund increase and revenue source
requirements.requirement: A general fund budget increase may be made by governing-body resolution, with the source of revenue shown.
requirements.finding: The proposed resolution lists a $641,172 general-fund increase sourced from reserves, and the minutes record adoption. The final signed text and actual reserve balances have not been checked.
requirements.next: Compare the signed adopted resolution and underlying general-fund reserve ledger with the proposed packet.

requirements.title: Proposed revenue and appropriation totals
requirements.law: Wyo. Stat. §§ 16-4-112–114; review applicable budget balancing requirements
requirements.requirement: Compare proposed and adopted appropriations with available revenues and the applicable statutory restrictions, using unrounded amounts and fund-level records.
requirements.finding: The packet’s rounded proposed TOTAL APPROPRIATIONS shows $322,965,585, whereas its rounded TOTAL REVENUES shows $322,965,584, an apparent $1 difference. The tables include unrounded figures and rounding may explain it; neither the signed final text nor the ledger has been checked. This discrepancy alone does not establish an unlawful or unbalanced budget.
requirements.next: Reconcile unrounded underlying amounts and the signed Resolution 6508 with the accounting ledger and determine whether any actual imbalance exists.
